sentences.text:
Author: Surepalli Nanda
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 W.P.No.10757 Of 2023
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.1 to 4, and learned Standing Counsel for Municipality appearing on behalf of respondent No.5.
2.

The petitioner has approached this Court, seeking the following relief:
"...to issue an appropriate Writ Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus to declare the action of the respondents in acquiring Petitioners land in Sy. No. 15, to an extent of Ac.0-34 gts, Situated at Amarawadi Shivar Village, Mandamarri Mandal, Mancherial District, without initiating any land acquisition proceedings and without paying the compensation, under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as being illegal, arbitrary,
unconstitutional and violative of Article 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India,
and consequently direct the respondents authorities to not to take any coercive steps without following the due process of Law, and to grant such other order...."
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the 5th respondent brings on record the Lr.Roc.No.G1/378/2019, dated 04.02.2021 and also the proceedings No.D40414/20/2020, dated 12.08.2022 and contends that permission had been granted for handing over advance possession of the said Government land to the Commissioner, Kyathanpally Municipality and orders to that effect had been issued.
4.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner disputes the contention of the 5th respondent and represents that the petitioner's representation dated 03.04.2023 may be disposed of in accordance to law.

5. The representation of the petitioner dated 03.04.2023 reads as under:
Preamble: The Kyathanpalli Municipal authorities initiated to carry out construction of burial ground in our land without issuance of any Notice to us, for that submitted application on 27.02.2023 with the District Collector, then ordered for stoppage of such construction works and make out stopped.

The Mandamarri Mandal Tahsildar along with some Police Staff came to the land and threatened us and highhandedly Merugu Brahmaiah vs The State Of Telangana, on 7 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166270084/
1 commenced construction work in the said land on -01.04.2023.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The authorities with the support of the Tahsildar, Mandamarri encroaching my land, that the said land belongs to me i.e., S.C. Madiga Caste People,
for burial ground.

Hence, you the benign authority, may kind enough on me - downtrodden Madiga Community person by issuance of orders to the Revenue Staff, Municipal Staff and Police Staff and see that no construction should took place in my land for burial ground and do justice to me.

6. Without going into the merits and demerits of the case, the writ petition is disposed of, directing the 4th respondent to consider the petitioner's representation dated 03.04.2023 in accordance to law and pass appropriate orders within a period of three (03) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
Till the representation of the petitioner is considered and appropriate orders passed, the petitioner shall not be dispossessed from the subject land.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
